description: Native Enyo 8-runtime-bucket Bullet/SF-binpack smoke. This tests a true low-bucket runtime architecture instead of training low buckets and expanding them at load time.

metadata.hypothesis: A true 8-king-bucket runtime net may reduce bucket starvation and improve early native scratch behavior compared with 16/32-bucket layouts. The engine is compiled for 8 buckets, so the exported net is not expanded at load time.
constraints: runtime buckets must match the 8-bucket Enyo engine
bucket count is compile-time selected in the engine, not runtime-dispatched

validation.first_gate: checkpoint sweep at 0,512,1024,1536,2048 on the 800-target lichess policy gate using the 8-bucket engine
validation.promotion: no SPRT unless checkpoint gate is materially better than the prior expanded low-bucket smokes and failure replay is clean
